## Problem Statement
Consumers need validated ledger entries and deterministic tenant reconciliation totals without silent data loss.

## Solution
Validate newline JSON via parseLedger, then produce NDJSON summaries via renderSummary in session two.

Public APIs remain parseLedger(text:string):Entry[] and renderSummary(entries:Entry[]):string. Entry has tenant:string, visitId:string, cents:number. Empty lines are ignored. Implementing renderSummary in session one; external services, dependencies, Git operations, independent agents, method changes.
